result_preview.title: Material Receipt Inbound API
result_preview.shortDescription: REST API for creating and managing goods receipt transactions against purchase orders.
result_preview.description: Enables integration systems and warehouse management applications to post goods receipts in real-time against procured materials. Supports batch material receipt posting, quality inspection workflows, and stock reservation updates. Critical for supply chain visibility and inventory accuracy in manufacturing operations.

result_preview.title: Material and Vendor Master Data API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages material specifications and vendor master records for procurement operations.
result_preview.description: This API exposes comprehensive material and vendor master data, enabling systems to retrieve standardized product information, vendor attributes, and procurement-relevant classifications. It provides access to material hierarchies, vendor certifications, compliance statuses, and sourcing preferences to support goods receipt workflows and inbound logistics processing.

result_preview.title: Material and Vendor Inventory Management
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages material stock levels and vendor supply chain data.
result_preview.description: Exposes real-time material inventory records and vendor information to support production scheduling and procurement workflows. Provides access to material availability, reorder points, and vendor performance metrics for optimized supply chain operations. Manages material-to-vendor relationships to ensure accurate sourcing and inventory replenishment across manufacturing facilities.
